identity.boundModel: UPLOAD FIND/SEND/ABORT and INFORMATION only; no DOWNLOAD/AFDX
identity.claimStatus: non-confirmatory; DEC-IUT and DEC-EQUIV remain OPEN

normal.mechanism: no perturbation; complete FIND then SEND under a fresh reset
normal.observableSignature: terminal-status COMPLETED with owned FIND and SEND records
normal.notes: A normal singleton is not protocol PASS.

hSingle.mechanism: emit WAIT then a delayed CONTINUE while the upload obligation remains active
hSingle.observableSignature: WAIT status observed before CONTINUE; obligation not cancelled

hSingle.mechanism: after a status file carrying exceptionDelaySeconds, suppress the next status and the data-loader abort fallback
hSingle.observableSignature: status-with-delay observed; neither timely new status nor abort fallback before the finite observation end

hSingle.mechanism: deliver an owned ABORT for the active SEND correlation during transfer
hSingle.observableSignature: ABORT event with the same correlation key as the active SEND

hSingle.mechanism: issue a second INFORMATION request that reuses the live correlation key
hSingle.observableSignature: two INFORMATION requests share one correlation key while both are outstanding

hSingle.mechanism: select the registered batch policy instead of the single-file policy on an otherwise identical reset target
hSingle.observableSignature: publicConfigurationRef equals BATCH while pairing identity is shared

evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.mechanism: evaluator corrupts capture timestamp or ownership evidence; not an IUT-fault label
evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.observableSignature: observation record missing correlation id or invalid timestamp
evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.notes: Retained in attempt accounting; excluded from IUT PASS/FAIL denominators.

evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.mechanism: resource controller raises a named tool error without IUT nonconformance
evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.observableSignature: resourceStatus RESOURCE-ERROR with spent cost retained
